topic_coverage.quoted_user_text:
1. Typische Runs sollen deutlich weniger Input-Tokens verbrauchen.
2. Codequalität, QA, UAT und Release-Sicherheit sollen ungefähr gleich bleiben.
3. Jede Rolle/Phase/Aufgabenklasse muss ein eigenes Modell verwenden können.
4. Modelle unterschiedlicher Provider müssen gleichzeitig unterstützt werden:
   - lokale OpenAI-kompatible APIs / LM Studio
   - OpenAI
   - OpenRouter
   - KIE.ai
   - Anthropic oder weitere Provider
5. Modellwahl darf nicht nur vom Host Cursor/OpenCode abhängen, sondern muss Teil von its-magic selbst sein.
Cursor/OpenCode-spezifische Model Catalogs dürfen weiterhin Adapter sein, aber NICHT die Source of Truth für Routing.

decomposition.why_not_split: INTAKE_GUIDED_MODE=0. The operator did not ask to split. One outcome: fewer input tokens via context packs and slimmer memory, plus its-magic-owned per-role/per-task model routing across providers, while existing quality, QA, UAT, release, isolation, and strict-proof gates stay.

duplicate_check.rationale: No OPEN or DONE story already owns this v2 scope. US-0053 is TOKEN_PROFILE compaction. US-0072 is hot-surface archive and minimal reads. US-0080 is measured cache-read slimming. US-0089 and US-0090 are caveman voice and optional file compression. US-0096 is delivery-mode lifecycle shape. US-0123 and US-0132 are host catalogs for OpenCode and Cursor. US-0135 is standalone auth and Pi routing. This story is the delta: context packs and slimmer memory, plus its-magic-owned host-neutral routing. Those stories stay as they are.

non_goals.do_not_delete_gates: Do not delete quality, QA, UAT, release, isolation, or strict-proof gates to save tokens. Do not weaken US-0048, US-0056, US-0069, or US-0039.
non_goals.do_not_replace_token_profile: Do not silently replace TOKEN_PROFILE. It stays the context-breadth axis.
non_goals.do_not_reopen_caveman: Do not reopen US-0089 or US-0090 as this story.
non_goals.template_parity: This intake does not mirror template/docs/product. Recent story intakes US-0157 through US-0161 did not either.
non_goals.resume_brief: Story intake does not refresh handoffs/resume_brief.md.

bug_routing_guard.note: Exit 0 does not allocate a BUG id. US-0162 allocated after the guard. Prose describes the new capability.

priority_rationale: P0 because the specification Hauptziele treat fewer input tokens and its-magic-owned model choice as operator-critical, and the core workstreams are marked P0.
